text: Progress on 'build everything remaining', and two honest findings. (1) PropLine: the +EV sweep isn't running now (its last-run time and rows are 0 in the engine status), so it's spending no requests, and the screen already shows only edges after Vigilant's own prop cut. I'm leaving it as is; nothing to remove. (2) The 12-second error is Novig not finishing a fill order within 12 s; the app then says 'Unconfirmed' and tells you to Sync. I can't fix Novig's side, and I need a Diagnostics file from a failing bet to see if it's one market or all. Already shipped earlier: the standby labels (CH3), the Live status line (CH1), the sticky Odds API key (CH6a). Still not built: the live items (score-event trigger, second sharp source, live bids pulled on socket moves, the 0.75-0.89 paper tier). Those need paper results before real money, so I'm building them as paper-only next.
